messages:
anya: @channel Launching DocShip and the Compatibility Corridor policy today. Short: 90-day compatibility guarantee for managed SDK minor releases, 180 days for Private. DocShip = checklist + migration templates + QA prompt set + rollback recipes. Please skim and react.

lina: where's the checklist?

anya: draft: https://redwood.internal/docs/docship-v1. Use the migration template in the repo when cutting SDK PRs.

ben: can we require a smoke job that runs the QA prompt set on canary builds?

infra-bot: infra task created: JOB-1124 to add SDK canary smoke tests.

anya: yes, Platform will gate on that. SDK owners should add the QA prompt runner to CI.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood/prs/5073, migration template attached.

lina: telemetry question: is there any auto-collection?

anya: telemetry is opt-in only (field: compat_reporting_enabled). No request bodies, no prompts, no PII. Security review incoming.

ben: timeline?

anya: policy effective Monday. Checklist usable now as draft. We'll pilot with JS SDK next week.

lina: I'll take the JS migration snippets.

anya: thanks Lina. Please note consumer-facing language should avoid the word "deprecation"; use "scheduled change" in Console messages.

ben: :thumbsup:

anya: If you're contributing, add a short note to the PR so we can assign reviewers. Thanks!
